text:
yara: heads-up — in staging a dedicated tenant fell back to hosted and we lost the x-serve-affinity header, resulting in hosted routing to a cheaper variant and lower-quality outputs. repro attached.

toby: can you paste the before/after header snapshot?

yara: before handoff:
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: dedicated.gateway
x-tenant-id: t-9
x-serve-affinity: gpu-p4;lease=ls-77
```
after to hosted:
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.com
x-tenant-id: t-9
# x-serve-affinity missing
```
irene: that explains model mismatch. affinity is used to choose quantized vs fp16 variants.

manu: high-level fix: don’t trust raw headers across boundaries. need provable provenance for affinity/probe info. options: mTLS client cert with SAN, signed lease assertion, opaque token federation, or explicit opt-in header passthrough.

rachel: signed-assertion sounds right: compact JWS carrying {lease,affinity,iat,exp} signed by tenant key exchanged at onboarding. hosted verifies and caches per-lease. works for air-gapped if key exchange is offline.

sec-bot: security note: header re-injection must be behind an opt-in and audited; default must be deny.

toby: implementation sketch: add manifest field "affinity_provenance:[mtls|signed|opaque|header_optin]". if absent, deny affinity promotions on hosted.

irene: perf: verify once per lease and reuse; for mtls leverage TLS session cache. emit metric fallback.reason=affinity_lost.

manu: action items: toby draft manifest PR (1d), rachel prototype JWS format and cache (2d), sec-bot do security review (3d), yara add integration test simulating sidecarless handoff (1d). ops-bot: run handshake-affinity-matrix CI.

yara: agree. will file RFC follow-up and add console card to show affinity provenance per-tenant. thanks. :white_check_mark:
